text:
sophie_partners: Heads up 1 - we need a focused smoke plan to validate end-to-end compatibility for the retail POC connectors (Snowflake, Databricks Delta + Qdrant/Milvus). This is pre-marketplace packaging: verify schema mapping, throughput, and a basic cost delta. Target week of Apr 20. Who can drive infra and partner creds?

mike_infra: I can run infra and CI jobs. Suggest a tiny dataset first: s3://redwood-tests/retail-mini-5m. We'll do 2h smoke, then 12h soak if stable. Need partner creds and a list of connector versions.

lina_integrations: I'll coordinate connector versions with partners. For Snowflake we'll test v1.3.x and v1.4-rc, DBX connector v2.0 and our shim adapter. Also need tables for schema tests: product_id (string), ts (iso8601), price (float), embedding (float[]).

kevin_hw: Hardware partner (AuroraEdge) offered a small A40 pool for index experiments. We can test index build times vs cloud-only. Tradeoffs: A40 helps index speed but increases cost.

anna_sales: I'll request dev warehouses from Snow with minimal credit caps and a DBX dev cluster. I'll also flag this as a partner-only dry-run (no public announcement).

mike_infra: Proposed smoke checklist:
```
- deploy connectors (SF, DBX)
- ingest 100k rows with embedding builds
- run 30m of concurrent queries (5 clients)
- verify schema fidelity + no dropped fields
- check connector restart behavior under transient network loss
```

mia_qc: I'll own verification harness: schema diff, sample row checks, and a small suite of 10 regression prompts to validate embedding fidelity. Will post results to a shared gist.

lina_integrations: Important: add tests for DELTA merges on DBX (upserts), Snowflake COPY INTO and streaming ingest. Edge case: timestamp timezone offsets - partners sometimes send epoch ms, others ISO. Normalize in test harness.

mike_infra: Ingest command for smoke run (local harness):
```
./tools/run_ingest.sh --dataset s3://redwood-tests/retail-mini-5m --target snowflake --concurrency 8 --batch 512 --trace smoke-2923
```

devops-bot: CI pipeline created: https://ci.internal/rw/pipelines/adapter-smoke-2923. Job `smoke-snowflake` and `smoke-dbx` added.

kevin_hw: For A40 tests, label nodes `aurora-small` and limit parallel index builders to 2. I'll send node reservation window.

anna_sales: Partners asked for a 1-page plan. Lina/Mike, can you draft and I'll pass along? Also include rollback/fallback plan for connectors.

mia_qc: Success criteria proposal: smoke pass if schema match >99.5%, no connector crashes in 2h, query p95 < 200ms for vector lookups at 5qps. Fail otherwise and escalate.

lina_integrations: Note: cataloging for marketplace needs metadata file (connector.yaml) describing supported versions, config knobs, and data residency. We'll draft that after a clean smoke run.

mike_infra: I'll provision k8s jobs and a Grafana dashboard (ingest-rate, error-rate, connector-uptime). Push infra PR by EOD Mon.

sophie_partners: Great. Keep updates compact here. Post one-line completion notes when each smoke run finishes (e.g., "snowflake smoke - pass - 2023-04-21T10:23Z"). Thanks :sparkles:
